narrationTexts: I'll start by looking at the project.
finalText:
**Build passes now.** Two real bugs from the bump, not noise.

`resolveRetries` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler sends `retryCount`. It threw `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'toFixed')`. Now it takes either. See [options.js:5](src/core/options.js:5).

`isBackoffEnabled` threw on unset flags. The new loader gives `undefined`, not `false`. Unset now means off. See [retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7).

The 8 warnings are all deprecation noise. `Buffer()`, `punycode`, `crypto.createCipher` and 5 more.

Next: swap those deprecated APIs before v5.
